rec: A charged glory or a combat bracelet
enemies: The ability to run past level 172 black demons and level 64 poison spiders
rewards: Ability to have Thormac turn a Battlestaff into a Mystic Staff for 40,000 Coins.

st.t: Speak to Thormac on the top floor of the Sorcerer's Tower south of Seer's Village.
s: What do you need assistance with?
So how would I go about catching them then?
Ok, I will do it then

st.t: Speak to a seer in Seer's Village.
s: I need to locate some scorpions.
Your friend Thormac sent me to speak to you.

st.t: If you have 80 Agility, go over the strange floor. If you have 70 Agility, squeeze through the obstacle pipe. Either way, skip to Search the Old wall. With less than 70 Agility you need a dusty key: if you have one, skip to entering the gate.

Only if you need a dusty key: travel through Taverley Dungeon to the Black Knights' Base. Kill the Jailer in the east side of the base and pick up the jail key. Use it on the south door and talk to Velrak for a dusty key.
s: So... do you know anywhere good to explore?

st.t: Only if you are using a dusty key: enter the gate to the deeper Taverley dungeon.
In the poison spider area, search the Old wall directly south of the strange floor (the 80 Agility shortcut) to enter a small room.
Use the scorpion cage on the scorpion.

Climb the south-east ladder in the Edgeville Monastery to the upper floor. If you're stopped, ask to join the order (you need 31 Prayer). The scorpion is at the top of the ladder or in the bedroom just north of it.
s: Well can I join your order?

st.t: Use the scorpion cage on the scorpion.

Go into the fenced area by the Agility course entrance (this needs Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl), then into the building in its north-east corner. The scorpion wanders just inside. Use the scorpion cage on it.
Return to Thormac to finish the quest.
